<function name="CanDrive" parent="SANDBOX" type="hook">
	<description>Called when a player attempts to drive a prop via Prop Drive</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<predicted>Yes</predicted>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player who attempted to use Prop Drive.</arg>
		<arg name="ent" type="Entity">The entity the player is attempting to drive</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to allow driving, false to disallow</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Stops nonadmins from using Prop Drive</description>
	<code>
function GM:CanDrive( ply, ent )
	if !ply:IsAdmin() then return false end
end
	</code>

</example>
